data_fields.name: drop_every_n
data_fields.donor_constant: cCaseFactor = 5 (1 in 5 per turn-end pass); 0 disables

data_fields.name: health_share
data_fields.donor_constant: cHealthCaseProb = 35 (percent; times 100 out of 10000); 0 when invulnerable

best_idea: A two-level drop roll: a 1-in-N gate with a live cap, then a fixed share for the health class and a weighted split of the rest, with the item rolled only at collection.
decision_why: Keep the 1-in-N gate with a live cap, the fixed health share with its invulnerable exception and the collection-time item roll; move the cadence from a turn-end pass to a server round boundary and fail closed when every weight is zero instead of dropping health.
acceptance: Server test on a zone with 1-in-5 drops and a live cap of 5: a sixth live box never appears under a fixed seed; boxes are health about 35% of the time when not invulnerable and never health when invulnerable; the item is chosen only at collection; a zone with no item weights rejects the drop.
